recoveryAssessments.comparison: The new bound applies to the subclass with all-ones right-hand side and nonzero columns. Any solver for the general binary-coefficient task must handle this subclass. The W[1] exclusion is therefore a logarithmic recovery for the general task, using a computable convergence cutoff and an arbitrary fixed polynomial in the complete input length. The ETH k log₂ k exclusion concerns general right-hand sides. The all-ones subclass has a 2^k N^(O(1)) subset algorithm.
